verdict.rationale: Notion has a documented REST API with an OpenAPI spec discoverable at a public endpoint and developer docs (notion-docs-1, notion-probe-2, notion-probe-1), implying structured API reference material, but there's no direct evidence of an interactive reference with runnable/try-it-now examples (like Swagger UI or Postman-style consoles) or community confirmation of such interactivity. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive 'try it' console or runnable code examples in the docs, independent corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
